name: ragtruth
task: Response-level hallucination detection for retrieval-augmented generation (binary: clean vs hallucinated)
input_format: first segment: 'Task: <task_type>. Source: <source_info>'; second segment: response
split: official train/test; validation = 20% of train grouped by source_id (GroupShuffleSplit, seed 42)
limitations: Test F1 (0.685) is lower than validation F1 (0.740); hallucination rate drops from 44.9% (validation) to 34.9% (test), which lowers precision.
About 42% of flagged responses are false alarms (precision 0.58); recall is 0.84.
Weak on Summary (F1 0.47) and QA (F1 0.54); strong on Data2txt (F1 0.84).
Gain over the response-only model is modest on test (F1 0.685 vs 0.665).
artifact_note: Model weights are not stored in git. The deployed app serves 10 precomputed real samples (data/demo/ragtruth_samples.json); the live model runs only on a machine that has the model folder under models/ragtruth/v0.1.0/.
